title: Inguinal hernia wounds that suppurated at the Johns Hopkins Hospital, 1889–1899, by closure and gloves
description: Bar chart of the share of inguinal hernia operation wounds that suppurated, from Joseph Bloodgood's 1899 report: 116 wounds closed with silk, operator without gloves, 28 suppurated (24.1 percent); 104 closed with silver wire, operator without gloves, 10 suppurated (9.6 percent); 226 closed with silver wire with the operator and every assistant gloved, from February 1897, 4 suppurated (1.8 percent).
heading: HERNIA WOUNDS THAT SUPPURATED · %
